_readme: Edit this file to add or remove items. See README.md for field definitions. Every entry needs a title and either a 'file' (path in this repo) or a 'url' (external link).

strategy.title: Digital Ad Campaign Playbook
strategy.description: Targeting, budget tiers, and creative specs for Meta and Google listing campaigns. Share with sellers during the listing presentation.

strategy.title: Billboard Placement Strategy
strategy.description: Market-by-market inventory, impression estimates, and design constraints for out-of-home buys.

strategy.title: Direct Mail Farming Guide
strategy.description: Geographic farming cadence, mailer sizing, and USPS EDDM walk-route selection.

strategy.title: Listing Launch Timeline (external)
strategy.description: Week-by-week launch sequence. Hosted doc — always shows the current version.

reports.title: Q3 2026 Digital Performance Report
reports.description: Impressions, CTR, cost per lead, and top-performing creative across all digital listing campaigns.

reports.title: Billboard Impression Study — Summer 2026
reports.description: Verified impression counts and brand-lift survey results from the summer out-of-home flight.

brand.title: Aperture Global Brand Guide
brand.description: Logo usage, clear space, color values, typography, and voice. The authoritative reference — check here before producing anything.

brand.title: Logo Pack (SVG, PNG, EPS)
brand.description: Primary, stacked, and monogram marks in full color, all-black, and reversed white.

brand.title: Listing Photography Sample
brand.description: Reference for the photography standard expected on all listing marketing — natural light, twilight exteriors, wide interiors.
